capabilityGroups.title: Find and import externally
capabilityGroups.description: Discover bounded metadata in authorized Slack, web, cloud-drive, Dropbox, and WebDAV sources, then copy reviewed media into safe managed storage with stable IDs.

capabilityGroups.title: Search and understand
capabilityGroups.description: Ask for images by meaning, text, people, places, dates, quality, media type, or exact metadata without browsing folders.
examples: Locate a serial number from OCR

capabilityGroups.title: Curate and organize
capabilityGroups.description: Turn reviewed stable IDs into albums, memories, favorites, metadata updates, and reusable collections without exposing source paths.

capabilityGroups.title: Edit and create
capabilityGroups.description: Plan non-destructive edits, contact sheets, slideshows, memory movies, cutouts, and alternate versions while keeping originals intact.

capabilityGroups.title: Export and deliver
capabilityGroups.description: Produce traceable artifacts with manifests, bounded output resources, color and metadata controls, and retry-safe execution.

capabilityGroups.title: Operate at library scale
capabilityGroups.description: Run indexing, archive health, backup, repair, deduplication, and export jobs over large libraries without repeating timed-out work.

capabilityGroups.title: Review people safely
capabilityGroups.description: Use consent-gated face workflows, bounded previews, explicit identity decisions, Safe Mode, and a tamper-evident activity trail.

platformFeatures.title: MCP and OpenAPI reach
platformFeatures.description: Use local stdio, authenticated Streamable HTTP, or 28 direct API operations from Codex, Claude, SDKs, and private services.

platformFeatures.title: Safety-controlled inbound reach
platformFeatures.description: Authorize connectors in the desktop, share credentials across local agent processes through the OS vault, discover metadata first, and require explicit confirmation before managed downloads.

platformFeatures.title: Interactive visual review
platformFeatures.description: Compatible MCP hosts can show a path-free result canvas, persist stable-ID selections, and request separately approved previews.

platformFeatures.title: Observable operations
platformFeatures.description: Follow imports, indexing, exports, repairs, and agent writes through one timeline, resumable events, manifests, and bounded outputs.

platformFeatures.title: Scoped enterprise access
platformFeatures.description: Use a local operator token, hash-only service accounts, or OAuth JWTs with six scopes, exact per-tool grants, expiry, and identity attribution.
